run.display_title: Verify Windows CRT payloads and harden macOS CI failure handling

head_commit.message:
Retry macOS release uploads and preserve native test crash evidence

Use case: A green PR should not leave master failures unrecoverable or
impossible to diagnose. Master run 39012301248 failed an artifact upload
with ENOTFOUND and a separate Vectorscan child with empty captured output.
The PR head, tested merge result, and master have identical source trees.

Root cause: Final artifact uploads are publish-event-only and had no
workflow-level retry. The child harness hid its collected exit code behind
a fatal exit-status assertion, and collection restore lacked phase logs.
The original child crash itself remains unexplained, not fixed or suppressed.

How to fix: Share a single bounded macOS release-upload retry, preserving
payloads, publication gates, retention, and fatal retry failure. Require
fault-injection contracts in early preflight and retain artifact ancestry
lint coverage. Record terminal child state and flushed startup/restore
phases; upload narrow crash reports and CTest logs only after test failure.
Do not retry tests, skip sanitizer coverage, or weaken ci-gate.

How to verify: Complete scripts/run_ci_quality.py passed all six lints and
2229 tests (8 skipped). Focused upload contracts (13), existing preflight
regressions (16), diagnostic contracts (8), and actionlint passed. Exact
Qt 6.9.3/Xcode 26.6 TSan vectorscan CTest passed 14 cases/68 assertions;
20 collection children and 100 instrumented Qt launch probes passed.
An earlier concurrent quality run hit an unchanged efsw fixture's 2-second
Git deadline; isolated tests and the complete serial rerun passed without
changing its deadline. Hosted crash collection and outage recovery remain
covered by offline contracts, not a reproduced hosted failure.

Refs #78

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
